title: SAT Exponential Growth and Decay, Explained
description:
Exponential functions show up across the SAT math section: percent growth, depreciation, half-life, doubling time, and equivalent forms. This lesson shows how to read y = a · bᵗ, then works through 6 SAT-style practice questions that get harder as they go.

You'll learn:
• What a and b mean in context (starting value and growth factor)
• Growth/decay rate vs. growth/decay factor (why 0.85 means −15%)
• Linear vs. exponential: constant difference vs. constant ratio
• Half-life and doubling-time forms with t/k in the exponent
• Equivalent forms for different time units (years vs. months)
• A 4-step method for any growth or decay question

All questions are original SAT-style questions written for this video, not official College Board questions. For official practice, use the free SAT Suite Question Bank.
